role.desc.REQUESTER: Files requests and follows their progress.
role.desc.STAFF: Does the work: takes assigned tasks, updates status, uploads results.
role.desc.TEAM_LEAD: Triages, assigns, monitors workload and reviews the team's output.
role.desc.ADMIN: Manages people and everything else, and sees all requests.
role.desc.MANAGEMENT: View-only: dashboards, deadlines and workload. Cannot change anything.
